name: forktex-core
description: Shared ForkTex Python substrate: 4-level catalog, database/cache/queue/vector/storage/store/vault/graph facades, Grid/Space/Flow pillars, and API/worker bootstraps

test.description: Automated tests verify behaviour at the unit and integration level, with a coverage floor
commands: @# The floor ratchets: it is the measured figure, so coverage cannot silently drop.
@# Raise it when a pass adds real coverage; never lower it to make a change pass.

typecheck.description: Static type system verifies interface correctness (pyright; install via dev deps)

audit.description: Scan the project venv for known CVEs in installed deps. Always uses `poetry run` so pip-audit reads the venv's installed packages, not the system Python (which would surface Ubuntu-shipped jinja2/cloud-init/ansible etc. — irrelevant to this library).

build.description: Build sdist + wheel into dist/ and verify metadata with twine check
commands: poetry run python3 -m twine check dist/*

publish-test.description: Upload dist/ to TestPyPI (https://test.pypi.org) for rehearsal
commands: poetry run python3 -m twine upload --repository testpypi dist/*

publish.description: Upload dist/ to production PyPI (irreversible per-version)
commands: poetry run python3 -m twine upload dist/*

license-check.description: Verify every source file carries the current AGPL-3.0 + Commercial dual-license header (CI gate)

license-fix.description: Add or update the dual-license header on every source file (idempotent)

license-strip.description: Remove the dual-license header from every source file (use before license model changes)

codegen.description: Not applicable: forktex-core has no schema-derived artifacts
commands: @echo 'codegen: not applicable for forktex-core (pure runtime library, no generated code)'

codegen-check.description: Not applicable: forktex-core has no generated artifacts to verify

ci.description: Aggregate quality gate before publish: format-check + lint + license-check + typecheck + audit + test + catalog-check + build + smoke
commands: @echo 'CI passed for $(PROJECT_NAME) — safe to: make publish-test  /  make publish'
poetry run python3 -m ruff check src/ tests/
lint.description: Static analysis catches bugs, anti-patterns, and security issues

commands: poetry run python3 -m ruff format --check src/ tests/
poetry run python3 -m ruff format src/ tests/
format.description: Source code conforms to a consistent, auto-enforced style

test-perf.description: Run the grid limits/performance suite (opt-in; writes a JSONL artifact under tests/test_grid/test_limits/.runs/). Not gated by `make ci`.
commands: poetry run python3 -m pytest tests/test_grid/test_limits/ -m perf -q -s

test-perf-headroom.description: Probe the 1M-row tier on operations that survived the main ladder. Slow (minutes); requires FORKTEX_PERF_HEADROOM=1.
commands: FORKTEX_PERF_HEADROOM=1 poetry run python3 -m pytest tests/test_grid/test_limits/test_headroom.py -m perf -q -s

test-perf-report.description: Render the latest grid perf JSONL artifact as a markdown table (grid_ms / native_ms (Nx)).

catalog-check.description: README's generated blocks match catalog.json (the machine SSOT)

smoke.description: Install the BUILT wheel into a throwaway venv and import every extra
commands: @# The gate `make ci` was missing: everything above tests the source tree, so a
@# packaging fault is invisible to it. `[worker]` shipped documented but
@# Importing the module is NOT sufficient to prove an extra exists — most
@# modules here import fine without their dependency (it is looked up lazily so
@# the error can name the extra). pip merely *warns* on an unknown extra and
@# exits 0, so that warning is what this greps for.

$$tmp/base/bin/python -c "import forktex_core.log, forktex_core.error, forktex_core.types, forktex_core.iso, forktex_core.database, forktex_core.grid, forktex_core.space, forktex_core.flow, forktex_core.graph, forktex_core.catalog; print('  base modules import')"; \
for x in worker api vault storage queue vector store; do \
if grep -q "does not provide the extra" $$tmp/log; then \
echo "  [$$x] FAIL — pyproject declares no '$$x' extra (pip only warns)"; exit 1; \
echo "smoke: every extra resolves and delivers a working module"

typing.description: Static type system verifies interface correctness across the codebase
commands: @# `poetry run`, not bare `python` — pyright resolves imports from the
@# interpreter's environment, and `poetry run` is what exports `VIRTUAL_ENV`
@# for it. Run bare and you get ~210 phantom `reportMissingImports` errors
@# that look like real type errors. `typecheck` is the same command.

license.description: Source headers and dependency licenses verified against policy

test-cov.description: Run the suite with coverage reporting

security.description: Dependencies and code scanned for known vulnerabilities and security smells

commands: poetry run python3 -m ruff check --fix src/ tests/

packages.name: forktex-core
packages.description: Shared ForkTex substrate library: database/cache/queue/vector/storage/vault/graph facades plus Grid/Space/Flow
